content.short: Chips is a mobile game that attempts to curb crime, violence, and poverty by incentivizing positive decisions.
content.description: In Chips, your task is to explore the open world and participate in various activities. As you partake in them, you’ll undoubtedly meet challenges where you need to make the correct choice or do something for the good of society. This mobile play-to-earn game includes 2 game coinsthe "CHIP" coin and the "CRUMB" token. The CHIP coin is the governance token in the Chips metaverse. Its functionalities are linked to DAO operations.[1 Chip coin = 10 Crumb tokens] The CRUMB token is the in-game monetary asset.
content.meta: Find out about Chips (CHIP) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
